sections.shortTitle: PUNJAB URBAN IMMOVABLE PROPERTY TAX AMENDMENT ACT 2005
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT IV OF 2005
ACT IV OF 2005
PUNJAB
URBAN IMMOVABLE PROPERTY TAX (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2005
An Act
further to amend the Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958
[Gazette of Punjab, Extraordinary, 15th April, 2005]
No.PAP-Legis-2(22)/2005/722, dated 15-4-2005.---The Punjab Urban
Immovable Property Tax (Amendment) Bill 2005, having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on 8 April 2005, and assented to by the
Governor of the Punjab on 13 April, 2005, is hereby published as an Act of the
Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Act
may be called the Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax (Amendment) Act, 2005.
(2) It shall come into force with
effect from first day of July 2004.

sections.shortTitle: PUNJAB URBAN IMMOVABLE PROPERTY TAX AMENDMENT ACT 2005
sections.description:
Amendment in section 4 of Act V of 1958

ACT IV OF 2005
ACT IV OF 2005
PUNJAB
URBAN IMMOVABLE PROPERTY TAX (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2005
An Act
further to amend the Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958
[Gazette of Punjab, Extraordinary, 15th April, 2005]
No.PAP-Legis-2(22)/2005/722, dated 15-4-2005.---The Punjab Urban
Immovable Property Tax (Amendment) Bill 2005, having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on 8 April 2005, and assented to by the
Governor of the Punjab on 13 April, 2005, is hereby published as an Act of the
Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
2. Amendment in section 4 of
Act V of 1958.---In the
said Act, in section 4, clause (i) shall be substituted as follows:-‑
"(i) One
residential house, measuring an area up to five Marlas, used for residential
purpose, irrespective of its annual value. "
